title: Freight arrival targets
bodyMd:
The table counts consignments scheduled in one month and those arriving within the contracted window. Every scheduled consignment is tracked.

| Category | Scheduled consignments | On-time arrivals |
|---|---:|---:|
| Rail | 100 | 92 |
| Road | 150 | 132 |
| Sea | 250 | 200 |
